summary.text: Eric Davanzo is a Republican state representative from Westmoreland County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 58 since April 6, 2020, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before taking office he was a carpenter superintendent for the Eastern Atlantic States Regional Council of Carpenters.

paragraphs.text: Davanzo worked as a carpenter superintendent for the Eastern Atlantic States Regional Council of Carpenters before he took office, and his official biography says he remains an active member of the union.
In that role, according to the biography, he managed projects while controlling costs and containing budgets.
Davanzo was sworn in on April 6, 2020, and his official biography says he has supported legislation on family-sustaining jobs, infrastructure and education.
He passed Act 7 of 2022, which designates a portion of State Route 31 in South Huntingdon Township as the John Michael Beyrand Memorial Highway.
For the 2025-26 session he serves on the Appropriations, Education, Finance, Game and Fisheries and Transportation committees and is a Republican deputy whip.

His biography lists his priorities as supporting veterans, defending pro-life values, supporting law enforcement and Second Amendment rights, and he serves on the Westmoreland County Broadband Task Force.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Cherri Rogers as his opponent in the general election.
